I rent this small wheat plot, so I must be careful with money. I will buy some DAP and urea from the cooperative like most of us do here in Oromia, but only a little because the plot is small and fertilizer is expensive. I cannot afford improved seed every year, so I will use seed I kept from last harvest. There is no irrigation here — we depend on the meher rains — and I will work the plot myself with my family, maybe calling a few neighbors for weeding and harvest.
